cases.name: Client registration and login
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Register a synthetic Client, confirm through isolated mail capture, test the nine selected-role/account-role combinations, invalid credentials and missing profile; assert mismatch logout/cache removal and no workspace redirect.

cases.name: Provider registration and login
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Register a synthetic Provider; verify Auth trigger persists only Client/Provider and ignores forged Admin metadata; test confirmation, recovery and session revocation with mail capture.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Mandatory identity verification
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Submit inert generated PDF/PNG, explicit true consents, owned paths; race two submissions, expect exactly one pending. Deny false/omitted consent, forged role/reviewer/status and foreign/missing document.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Admin approval and rejection
cases.procedure_and_assertions: With existing synthetic Admin approve pending consented Client/Provider, reject with reason, resubmit; assert users flags and Provider badge atomically agree. Replayed final decisions denied without duplicate notifications.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Pending/rejected user access denial
cases.procedure_and_assertions: For not-submitted, pending, rejected, mismatched latest history and legacy flag-only users, deny all workspace tables/RPCs via REST, not only UI. Own verification and account reads remain available.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Direct REST restrictions
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Compare schema/ACL with reviewed contracts; anonymous and unrelated users denied raw users, requests, Provider data, receipts, reports and authority-field PATCH. Test explicit private-schema Accept-Profile and Content-Profile as anon/auth, including inherited privileges, readable views and default EXECUTE grants.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: RPC authorization
cases.procedure_and_assertions: For every public RPC try anonymous, wrong-role, suspended, unapproved and unrelated IDs. Private mutation helpers must not be remotely routable/callable. Assert no side effects after denials.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Private Storage access
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Upload inert docs/receipts/evidence as synthetic owners; deny anonymous URLs, foreign owner folders, update/upsert and receipt delete. Allow only authorized owner/participant/Admin signed reads. Verify token expiry after 300s, refresh and signed-link limitations.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Client request creation
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Approved Client creates correct category/specialization/date/time/GPS. Race identical idempotency key, expect one request/ID; simulate lost response and retry, expect original ID; changed details same key must fail. Preserve image-failure edit retry.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Recommendation accuracy
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Seed matching/nonmatching categories, specializations, unavailable/unverified/inactive/declined Providers, weekly hours/boundaries, missing coordinates and other-Client same-slot bookings. Compare exact eligible set, distance order, complete review/completion aggregates and limited feedback; no raw coordinates/contact/booking details.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Provider selection
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Client selects only from own pending request and eligible target; reject forged/inactive/unapproved/unavailable/declined/conflicting target. Exact repeat is idempotent. Provider cannot browse other open requests or apply.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Provider confirm and decline
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Only selected approved Provider confirms/declines; verify reason, decline history/exclusion and rematching. Exact repeated transition has no duplicate event; stale/invalid transitions fail. Two same-slot legacy selections may not both confirm.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Messaging
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Only current service pair can send; own sender enforced, receiver can update only read flag. Unrelated, former Provider, suspended and revoked sessions denied sending. Concurrent thread navigation preserves drafts/recipient; no arbitrary notification insert.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Service completion
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Provider starts only confirmed own service; Client completes only own in-progress service. Race cancel/start/complete, assert valid serial result and history retained. Validate repeat versus stale transition behavior.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Payment recording
cases.procedure_and_assertions: After completion Client records Cash or transfer with owned private proof. Race duplicate request payment, expect one. Deny wrong payer/provider/amount/method/missing transfer proof. Resolve consistent path and legacy URL-only proofs; reject foreign URL, mismatched path, traversal, ambiguous ID, missing/foreign object; no public URL persistence.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Ratings and reviews
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Both participants can review completed service once; race duplicates and enforce rating range/participant pairing. Deny premature/wrong target review. Compare recommendation aggregate across all records, no browser-limited statistics.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Admin monitoring
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Admin monitors tables and private proofs, reviews participant reports with owned evidence; require active existing Admin. Browser cannot self-register/promote. Reconciliation queue paginates consistently without changing flags/history; no real user data in exports/screenshots.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Account suspension
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Admin RPC must use account_status, suspend synthetic Client/Provider with active work; direct REST reads/writes/RPCs denied after status change; preserve all assignments/history. Test cross-tab sign-out and invalid refresh tokens; decide self/last-Admin policy separately.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Concurrent Provider assignments
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Run two Client JWTs concurrently selecting same Provider/exact date/time on different requests: exactly one succeeds; repeat at least 20 iterations, both arrival orders. Race profile availability/hours and suspension against selection, then confirm/decline/cancel. Inspect final rows/events independently as test operator; no duplicate active reservation.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)

cases.name: Atomic Provider profile updates
cases.procedure_and_assertions: Snapshot synthetic profile/skills/specs/hours/own basic fields; inject late unique/validation failure inside single RPC and compare every set unchanged. Successful save commits all sets; concurrent two saves yields one complete set, never mixed rows. Race with selection/suspension and check eligibility reflects committed state.
cases.prepared_entrypoint: tests/staging/integration.cjs (ordered full synthetic fixture run; --plan by default)
